candidate_program.name: bounded_rival_adjustment
candidate_program.rationale: Applies a bounded strongest-rival margin correction to reward per blocked count, preserving reward units and positive scores. Reach is local degree and maximum rival weight; arithmetic is fixed, while summary refresh remains charged and several feasible rivals can defeat the exchange proxy.

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
